# OACP (Open Agent Compliance Protocol) - AI Documentation Index

This file provides a comprehensive index of all OACP documentation for AI models and crawlers.
OACP is a governance layer for LangGraph that adds voting, consensus, and audit trails to multi-agent workflows.

## Main Documentation
- **Overview**: /docs/overview.md - Complete project overview and introduction
- **Quick Start**: /docs/quickstart.md - Getting started guide with examples
- **Installation**: /docs/installation.md - Detailed installation instructions
- **Configuration**: /docs/configuration.md - Environment and configuration setup

## Core Features
- **Governance Layer**: /docs/features/governance.md - Democratic decision-making for agents
- **Voting Strategies**: /docs/features/voting-strategies.md - Unanimous, majority, and weighted voting
- **Adaptive Prompting**: /docs/features/adaptive-prompting.md - Automatic prompt improvement
- **Audit Trails**: /docs/features/audit-trails.md - Complete logging and tracking
- **Consensus Mechanisms**: /docs/features/consensus.md - How agents reach agreements
- **Error Handling**: /docs/features/error-handling.md - Retry logic and fallback mechanisms

## Technical Documentation
- **Decorators**: /docs/api/decorators.md - @with_oacp and function decorators
- **Contracts**: /docs/api/contracts.md - DecisionContract and voting requirements
- **Storage Backends**: /docs/api/storage-backends.md - File, SQLite, PostgreSQL support
- **Events System**: /docs/api/events.md - Comprehensive event tracking
- **Context Management**: /docs/api/context.md - Execution context and state
- **LLM Integration**: /docs/api/llm-integration.md - Language model adapters
